title: Ameris Bank Promotes Homeownership with Wealth Watchers in Northeast Florida
summary: $50,000 donation continues multi-year partnership ATLANTA (June 25, 2026) Ameris Bank presented a $50,000 community investment to Wealth Watchers in support of ongoing efforts to expand financial education, economic empowerment, and homeownership opportunities throughout Northeast Florida. The donation highlights the strong partnership between Ameris Bank and Wealth Watchers, organizations that share a commitment to helping individuals and families build wealth through sustainable homeownership and financial wellness. This investment reflects Ameris Banks commitment to creating pathways to homeownership and supporting organizations that are making a meaningful impact in the communities we serve, said Ameris Bank Director of Community Lending Clyde Anderson.
